tasks.title: Owners edit status-page settings and create status and notify service tokens
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, status-screen/shared read-write/token/People files, status and token portions of Behavior and Checks; R3 Status page and shared rules; Decisions 4, 5 and 15; Security impact (console); Counterexamples (status locks, stale report and order). Pin @lorenzh/pulse-contract to the full merged main SHA containing 2.4.0, regenerate bun.lock, and keep all other dependency pins and the runtime package set unchanged. Build the complete Owner-only /status-page feature using routeRole(settings.edit) and the existing ProtectedRoute/form pipeline, with an immediate pre-write live role/session guard. Add shared bounded runtime reads and metadata-based writes following check-write (5000 ms, Bearer, quoted If-Match where required, no retries or redirects), and all four named ApiCall values. Extend People actions/targets with all five actions now and log only identities/outcomes for saved and unknown writes, never values or reference names. Add Status service [status] and Notify service [notify] token presets, map both to admin in missingScope, render the new-scope token list, and test creation end to end. Add only the status-page nav entry here with its exhaustive icon; notifications nav/route registration arrives together in T2. Status form covers name, logo URL, all contract theme colours in both modes plus font/radius tokens, four three-way switches, unset/reset choices, and keyboard-only Move up/Move down/Reset order controls that post and preserve input without requiring script. Fresh locked fields are read-only with their via text; reject a forged change before any outbound write. Show stale/never origin-unknown, rejected, saved-not-yet-applied, old-api, token-rejected and 412 input-preserved states. Use 65536-byte status forms and escape every value. Add tests and fixture pages here, including keyboard reorder in e2e/run.ts; final T2 runs the browser gate for both families. Update settings.edit and token docs with the console-first rollout.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail; a focused run may fail only the global 80% line coverage gate, which is enforced by the full suite. Owner saves via exactly 1 API write; Admin/Member/Viewer direct GET and POST /status-page give 403, as does a role change after a gated read and before write. Invalid Origin -> 403, invalid CSRF -> 403, form-token replay -> 409. Forged locked-field POST -> 422 and 0 writes. Form permits 65536 bytes and refuses larger bodies. A fresh lock shows Set by PULSE_STATUS_SHOW_CHECKS on pulse-status; at age 181000 ms report origins are unknown, database inputs editable and banner pulse-status has not reported; overrides are unknown is shown. Rejected apply, missing report, token failure, old-api 404, Saved, not yet applied and 412 input preservation are covered with literal fixture settings. Component order buttons keep edits and save literal [c,a,b], Reset yields no override; each theme/flag input maps to its R1 key and empty input removes it. Writes use timeout 5000 ms, 0 automatic retries, quoted revision and metadata outcomes; People rows are present for saved/unknown with 0 setting values.

tasks.title: Owners manage notification channels and resend failed deliveries from protected forms
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, notifications files, remaining Behavior, Checks and Completion evidence; R3 Notifications/shared rules; Decision 14 (requestId/resend), Decision 15 (People log); Security impact; Acceptance evidence. Build on T1 shared runtime boundary to implement list/new/edit/delete/failed/resend pages and register the notifications nav/icon only with working routes. Protect direct GET and POST of every path with settings.edit Owner role and repeat live guard immediately before writes. Show file origin read-only, whole-channel shadowed copies with Delete only, failed newest-200 entries with hasPayload-only Resend, command-state page, first-use zero channels and every old-api/token/stale/rejected/412 outcome. Editor exposes only the allowed transport/routing fields and env/file references, never literal secret/destination values, and refuses or strips forged forbidden fields before forwarding. Delete/resend forms retain 8192-byte limit, editors use 65536 bytes and preserve the existing Origin/type/size/repeated-field/CSRF/form-token order. Generate 24 random base64url requestId characters when rendering Resend and retain that same id on a lost-answer retry while preserving form-token replay protection; follow the R2 revision requirements and metadata outcome policy. Record saved/unknown People rows without key, secret or reference text. Complete fixture/browser/accessibility tests for both screens and all token presets, screenshots/manual bun start evidence and final security/CI/pinned-workflow/baseline evidence.

acceptance.command: bun test src/server.notifications.test.ts src/runtime-read.test.ts src/runtime-write.test.ts src/navigation.test.ts src/people-log.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; a focused run may fail only the global 80% line coverage gate, which is enforced by the full suite. Owner can list/create/edit/delete/read failures/resend; Admin/Member/Viewer direct GET and POST of every /notifications path give 403, and demotion before write gives 403 with 0 writes. Invalid Origin/CSRF/replayed form token give 403/403/409. File rows cannot be edited, shadowed database rows permit only Delete, and forged locked changes give 422 with 0 writes. Editor limit is 65536 bytes; delete/resend limit 8192; over-limit forms are refused. Cover literal old-api 404, 412 with kept input, token rejected, stale/never report, rejected apply and channels:[] states. No form has a secret-value input, and a forged url field yields 0 forwarded url keys. Failed list renders at most 200 newest rows and Resend only for hasPayload=true. requestId matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24}$ and a lost-answer retry repeats the same literal id; one click creates 1 command and command state is reread on load. People rows for saved and unknown have the specified action/identity and 0 settings values, references or delivery keys.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full test suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.
